## Core Treatment Protocols & Clinical Details

### 1. Acne Management & Clearance
- Indication: Active inflammatory acne, comedones, hormonal breakouts, cystic lesions.
- Technology/Formulations: Salicylic & mandelic acid chemical peels, 415nm blue light phototherapy, vacuum pore extractions, medical barrier repair topicals.
- Target Population: Teenagers and adults across South Mumbai.

### 2. Acne Scar Revision
- Indication: Post-acne textural scarring including ice-pick, boxcar, and rolling scars.
- Technology/Formulations: Fractional CO2 / Erbium laser resurfacing, DermaPen medical microneedling, autologous Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP), subcision.
- Downtime: 2–4 days of mild erythema.

### 3. Signature HydraFacial & Medi-Facials
- Indication: Dull skin, congested pores, blackheads, pre-wedding/event preparation.
- Technology/Formulations: 4-step patented vortex infusion system with glucosamine, lactic acid, salicylic peel, and hyaluronic acid peptide boosters.
- Downtime: Zero downtime, instant glass-skin radiance.

### 4. Diode Laser Hair Removal
- Indication: Unwanted facial and body hair, recurrent folliculitis, ingrown hairs.
- Technology/Formulations: FDA-cleared triple-wavelength (755nm + 808nm + 1064nm) in-motion diode laser with -4°C sapphire contact cooling.
- Efficacy: Up to 90% permanent hair reduction over 6–8 sessions.

### 5. Melasma & Hyperpigmentation
- Indication: Melasma, sun spots, tan, post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation.
- Technology/Formulations: Q-Switched Nd:YAG laser toning, tranexamic acid micro-infusions, customized depigmenting peels, glutathione antioxidants.

### 6. Anti-Aging, Botox & Dermal Fillers
- Indication: Forehead expression lines, crow's feet, frown lines, volume loss in under-eyes and cheeks, lip thinning, jawline sagging.
- Formulations: US-FDA approved botulinum toxin (Botox) and cross-linked hyaluronic acid dermal fillers (Juvederm, Restylane).
- Clinical Philosophy: Natural facial enhancement preserving expressions without frozen look.

### 7. Hair PRP & GFC Regrowth Therapy
- Indication: Androgenetic alopecia, diffuse hair thinning, telogen effluvium.
- Technology/Formulations: Autologous concentrated platelet-rich plasma and growth factor concentrate (GFC) micro-injected into follicular stem cell niches.
